confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors rest on a few aggregated menu and cost-of-living snippets with mixed dates (some from 2020 to 2024) and inconsistent sources; beer, coffee and wine are reasonably bounded, while the meal anchors are rougher. Cocktail was set from the local beer and rum-mix price relationship, since resort cocktail menus sit far above typical bar prices. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and the city context, not inspected listings, so they are the least certain and the hostel anchors especially so given limited hostel supply. Service charge and taxes are not uniformly included in the sourced prices.
comparable_city_reasoning: Priced against Barbados's pegged currency (BBD 2 per USD) and Caribbean island cost levels, with Bridgetown treated as a mid-to-high cost small Caribbean tourism destination. Food and drink used observed menu and cost-of-living ranges; accommodation used regional Caribbean tourism-market judgment.
